main_text.p: filiquas, imo ftercus cum porcis. Nam fornicatorij cæntus ( inquit D. Chryfoftomus Hom.38 in Matth.) multo mag s quàm stercora funt abominabiles, Ac queminadmodum fordes & limus aures corporis obftruere solent: fic meretricij cantus, huius feculi fabulæ, aures mentis folent obftruere atque immundas facere: quasi enim ftercus auribus immittunt huiufmodi colloquia. Hieron Epicharmo comico poetæ, quod præsente ipsius vxore dixisset quiddam inhonestum, multam dixit. Epicharmus Siculus erat, iuxta regionis naturam plurimi ioci. At rex tantum iudicauit esse tribuendum reuerentiæ coniugio, vt crimen existimaret, audiente vxore iocari lasciuius. Et Gnathæna meretrix reprehensa à Stilpone Philosopho, quod adolescentes corrumperet, Tu, inquit, egoque Stilpon in eodem hæremus crimine, qui adolescentes tecum versantes inutilia quædam & amatoria sophisimata doces, vt nihil referat cum Philosopho versentur an cum meretrice.

2 Ex contrario iam intelligitur, quid conueniat mulieri, eamque ornet, nempe non tam formositas corporis, quàm honestas mentis, sapientia, timor Domini, discipli na morum, obedientia, tractabilitas, pudicitia, interna pulchritudo, quæ animi est, & Deo Opt.Max.placet, 1.Pet.3. & valet etiam externa absente. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "multam" (the word after "Hieron ... dixisset quiddam inhonestum" is blurred; read as multam [?]); "Hom.38" is a faint numeral; "mag s" appears to be a printed spacing error for "magis" [?]; "vxore" and "iocari" are read as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed ("mini-"). The small mark below the last line at the right is not a catchword or a legible signature and is left out. The strip of letters along the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The page opens mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The text is set in roman with no italics or black letter visible.
